invoice_by_id.statement: SELECT tenant, id, revision, seats, details, updated_ms FROM invoice WHERE tenant = ? AND id = ? LIMIT ?

invoice_update.statement: UPDATE invoice SET revision = ?, seats = ?, details = ?, updated_ms = ? WHERE tenant = ? AND id = ? AND revision = ?

line_insert.statement: INSERT INTO invoice_line (invoice_id, line_key, id, quantity, price_minor, position) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

lines_by_invoice.statement: SELECT invoice_id, line_key, id, quantity, price_minor, position FROM invoice_line WHERE invoice_id = ? ORDER BY position LIMIT ?

membership_lookup.statement: SELECT actor, tenant FROM invoice_membership WHERE actor = ? AND tenant = ? LIMIT ?

replay_expire.statement: DELETE FROM invoice_replay WHERE actor = ? AND tenant = ? AND invoice_id = ? AND operation_id = ? AND recorded_ms < ?

replay_insert.statement: INSERT INTO invoice_replay (actor, tenant, invoice_id, operation_id, digest, result, revision, recorded_ms) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

replay_lookup.statement: SELECT actor, tenant, invoice_id, operation_id, digest, result, revision, recorded_ms FROM invoice_replay WHERE actor = ? AND tenant = ? AND invoice_id = ? AND operation_id = ? LIMIT ?

session_by_token.statement: SELECT token, actor, revoked_ms FROM invoice_session WHERE token = ? LIMIT ?
